domain_description: A US market in which individuals must locate a healthcare professional constrained simultaneously by their insurance plan network, geography and appointment availability, and in which independent clinical practices pay third parties for each new individual who books with them.

anonymized_roles.context_permitted: has a specific insurance plan; needs a provider that is genuinely covered, reachable, and available soon

anonymized_roles.label: Individual arranging care without usable insurance coverage
anonymized_roles.context_permitted: pays out of pocket; needs a price before committing

anonymized_roles.label: Owner-clinician of a small independent practice
anonymized_roles.context_permitted: has unfilled schedule capacity; pays per newly acquired individual; judges channels on blended cost per acquisition

anonymized_roles.label: Operations or front-office manager at a clinical practice

approved_jobs.statement: When I need a new provider in an unfamiliar area or after a plan change, help me get an appointment on the calendar with someone my plan actually covers, near enough to reach, and soon enough to matter.
When a listing says a provider takes my plan, help me confirm that is actually true before the visit, so I am not handed an out-of-network bill afterwards.
When every mental-health provider on my plan's list is full, unreachable, or no longer in network, help me actually reach one who will take me, without spending my working day on follow-up calls.
When something needs attention today and my usual provider is booked out, help me find a route to being seen quickly without a referral I do not have and without an unknown price.
When my schedule has unfilled capacity, help me decide which channels are worth paying for and what a newly acquired individual can cost me before the arithmetic stops working.
When acquisition charges land for appointments that never happened or for people we already treated, help me get them corrected and stop the monthly total from running away from me.
When inbound scheduling contact exceeds what staff can answer, including outside business hours, help me stop losing bookings to hold times and voicemail.
approved_jobs.note: Weakly supported. Rotating discovery only; may not be rendered as a core cell.

approved_jobs.statement: When people increasingly consult AI assistants before and instead of contacting a practice, help me understand what that changes about how care is found, chosen and booked this year.
approved_jobs.note: Broad-discovery only. Every rendering must carry a review-by date.
